name: Wise Agent
description: Wise Agent is an all-in-one real-estate CRM for leads, contacts, conversations, marketing, properties, calendars, transactions, commissions, tasks and team workflows.
agentUseSummary: Wise Agent is visible as an OAuth scope and provider-access review preview. Relay will not request client credentials, run consent or expose CRM tools while each documented business-data scope combines reads with record-changing authority and AI-agent access remains provider-reviewed.

capabilities.label: Review bounded Wise Agent OAuth access
capabilities.description: If provider approval and read-only scopes become available, expose only exact-account, privacy-redacted CRM summaries through typed tools.

blocked.label: Capture Wise Agent OAuth credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask an operator to paste a provider-issued client secret, authorization code, access token or refresh token into this preview.

blocked.label: Access private Wise Agent CRM data
blocked.description: Profiles, contacts, vendors, addresses, notes, teams, calendars, tasks, calls, properties, transactions and marketing content are unavailable.

blocked.label: Change Wise Agent records
blocked.description: Creating, updating, deleting, assigning, categorizing, attaching files to or otherwise changing CRM records is unavailable.

blocked.label: Create webhooks or login tokens
blocked.description: Relay will not register callback URLs, receive CRM change events, obtain login tokens or open authenticated Wise Agent sessions.

blocked.label: Run Wise Agent actions before review
blocked.description: No Wise Agent tool is callable until the provider approves AI-agent use and offers least-privilege read scopes, PKCE, exact tenant claims, token rotation and an auditable production contract.

approvalProfiles.label: Wise Agent OAuth and AI-access review
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable because the current scopes combine read and write authority and provider approval explicitly evaluates AI use.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable under Wise Agent's current coarse read-write scopes and provider-reviewed AI access.
No Hermes tools are callable under Wise Agent's current coarse read-write scopes and provider-reviewed AI access.

providerSetup.blocker: Wise Agent issues OAuth clients only after an API access request that identifies requested scopes and whether the integration uses an AI model. Its authorization-code flow supports user consent, refresh tokens and access/refresh revocation, but the documented contacts, properties, calendar, team and marketing scopes combine reads with create or update authority; properties also authorizes deletion. Public documentation does not specify PKCE, immutable account claims, refresh-token rotation or a stable AI-agent production policy.
providerSetup.nextAction: Request explicit production approval from Wise Agent for Relay's agent runtime and ask for separate read-only scopes, PKCE, immutable account and user claims, refresh-token rotation with replay detection, coordinated access/refresh revocation, rate limits, webhook signatures and replay protection, audit identifiers, privacy/deletion terms and a test tenant. Then implement only typed, bounded, redacted reads before considering separately approved mutations.

evidence.supports: Wise Agent documents a provider-issued OAuth 2.0 authorization-code client, user consent, bearer access tokens, refresh tokens and access/refresh revocation endpoints.

The profile scope is read-only, while team, marketing, contacts, properties and calendar scopes explicitly combine reads with updates or creation; the properties scope also authorizes a deleteProperty endpoint.
Wise Agent's API access request asks whether an integration involves an AI model and warns that giving credentials to AI agents is new and may result in changed or lost API access.
Wise Agent describes its current CRM as covering contact management, automated lead follow-up, marketing, transactions, commissions and team collaboration.
Wise Agent publishes a curated partner ecosystem, reinforcing that third-party production access is provider-managed.
